_comment: Seeded conceptual-retrieval test cases for the TRAVSR repo itself (self-index). Companion to queries-seeded-k8s.json but grounded in this repo's real symbols. Purpose: exercise get_context / ask_query end-to-end across EVERY retrieval scenario and edge case, and pin the #462 WS4 anchor-gated rerank recall-floor rescue (grounded prose that used to abstain must now surface as `weak`, while salad/nonsense must still abstain). Every `expect` token is a real symbol or file verified against .travsr/graph.db on 2026-07-29.

_schema.category: one of: literal | conceptual | cross | fuzzy | rare | generic | nonsense | salad | degenerate
_schema.query: the raw query text sent to get_context / ask
_schema.expect: array of symbol names and/or file paths; a run HITS if any appears in a returned seed row (name-or-path substring, as scored by run-seeded-*.mjs)
_schema.seeds: candidate symbol NAMES an agent would decompose from the query text alone (arm C of the seeded experiment) — empty for nonsense/salad
_schema.expect_abstain: true when the correct behavior is Confidence::None (no grounded answer). Absent = should return a grounded result.
_schema.min_confidence: optional lower bound the run should meet: strong | weak. Absent = unscored on confidence.
_schema.note: the specific scenario / edge case this row covers
